about_the_game:
BrainRooms - Brainrot Backrooms

Enter the twisted and terrifying world of BrainRooms - Brainrot Backrooms, a psychological horror experience where every turn brings you closer to madness. Trapped in an endless maze of decaying hallways and shifting realities, you must find all the elusive brainrot items while desperately trying to escape the cursed backrooms.

As you explore the labyrinthine corridors, your sanity will be tested by the presence of the brainrot entities—horrifying, mind-bending creatures that stalk the darkness. These entities are drawn to your presence, and if they find you, your mind will deteriorate further, plunging you deeper into the madness of the backrooms.

Your goal is simple: escape. Collect all the scattered brainrot items to unlock the key to your escape, but beware—the longer you stay, the more the backrooms twist and distort around you. The clock is ticking, and the entities are closing in.

Will you be able to maintain your sanity long enough to escape, or will the backrooms consume you completely?
